portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  To use Red Hat Network,
launch the Red Hat Update Agent with the following command:

up2date

This will start an interactive process that will result in the appropriate
RPMs being upgraded on your system.
portal_description:
Metacity is a simple window manager that integrates nicely with
GNOME 2.

Bugs fixed in these updated packages include:

- New windows would sometimes show up below other windows.

- In some cases new windows would not be focused when they are first shown.

- Changing the resizable status of windows would result in incorrect 
  drawing of the window frames.

- In some cases panels would appear above fullscreen windows.

Users are advised to upgrade to apply this update, which
resolves these issues.
